translations.web: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh; “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
translations.bsb: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Lord GOD. Wouldn’t I prefer that he turn from his ways and live?
translations.kjv: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
translations.asv: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked? saith the Lord Jehovah; and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?
